research_rationale:
EO 9405 (December 17, 1943, Franklin D. Roosevelt) is a short order read in full in the held Federal Register text (held Federal Register text, filed December 17, 1943). Its only operative command amends Subdivision IX of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules; the amendment is a restatement of paragraph 9 for "Farm Credit Administration:" positions in four kinds of credit institutions. Part III of EO 9830 (signed February 24, 1947; 12 FR 1259, issue of Tuesday, February 25, 1947) is the sentence "hereby revoked:" followed by a list of orders by number, and its enacting clause reads "effective May 1, 1947:" for all Parts alike. The list includes the row "No. 9405 of December 17, 1943.", so EO 9830 expressly revokes this order, and the order's own text states no period, condition or end date. The held EO 9830 text has no wording that saves or excepts any listed order. The first end is the express revocation, effective May 1, 1947.
